intro.uz: Bu — kutubxonadagi suhbat. Malika kutubxonachi bilan gaplashadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: kutubxonaga borish uchun sizga nima kerak?

paragraphs.en: Malika: Good afternoon! Can I get a library card, please? Librarian: Yes, of course. Write your name and address here, please.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Xayrli kun! Kutubxona kartasini olsam boʻladimi? Kutubxonachi: Ha, albatta. Iltimos, ismingiz va manzilingizni shu yerga yozing.

paragraphs.en: Malika: Thank you. Where are the English books? Librarian: They are on the second floor, next to the computers.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Rahmat. Ingliz tilidagi kitoblar qayerda? Kutubxonachi: Ular ikkinchi qavatda, kompyuterlarning yonida.

paragraphs.en: Malika: Can I take three books? Librarian: Yes, you can. You can keep them for two weeks.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Uchta kitob olsam boʻladimi? Kutubxonachi: Ha, mumkin. Ularni ikki hafta saqlashingiz mumkin.

paragraphs.en: Malika: Is the library open on Sunday? Librarian: No, it isn't. We are open from Monday to Saturday.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Kutubxona yakshanba kuni ochiqmi? Kutubxonachi: Yoʻq, ochiq emas. Biz dushanbadan shanbagacha ishlaymiz.

paragraphs.en: Malika: And can I use the computers? Librarian: Yes, but please be quiet!
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Kompyuterlardan ham foydalansam boʻladimi? Kutubxonachi: Ha, lekin iltimos, jim boʻling!

grammar.example: They are on the second floor, next to the computers.

explain.uz: «Can I get a library card, please?»
«Write your name and address here, please.»
«They are on the second floor, next to the computers.»

questions.prompt: How long can Malika keep the books?

explain.uz: «You can keep them for two weeks.» Uch — kitoblar soni.

questions.statement: The library is open on Sunday.

explain.uz: Yakshanba kuni yopiq: «No, it isn't.» — «from Monday to Saturday».
«Yes, but please be quiet!» — foydalanish mumkin, faqat jim boʻlish kerak.
